clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Farren's Report carries Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's findings on the local naga. He hopes the dispatch will win him a return to Stormwind.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle grew tired of Southshore's embattled coast, its local leadership, and its remote frontier. He had adventurers hunt the Daggerspine naga to gather proof of their threat, then gathered the findings into a formal report. Farren plans to send it to Major Samuelson, captain of the guard in Stormwind Keep, rather than to his commanding officer, Marshal Redpath. Samuelson trained Farren, and Farren hopes the report will show his competence and earn him an immediate transfer back to Stormwind City's comforts.
